AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Stylist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers being a beautician for the burgeoning aristocracy of an up-and-coming frontier world as it was absorbed by the Nephilim. She was adept at chatting with clients, carefully trimming hair, and recommending the newest in weight supportive fashions to her ever-growing clients.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Hive Worker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers living in a planet sized womb world--a planet subsumed by the nephila and under the process of being converted into the bulk of a single, planet-encompassing Nephilim entity. She worked in a massive production facility, overseeing the hulking worker drones serving as the architects of the world's evolution.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Pampered Socialite
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers being the favored daughter of a prominent glitterworld diplomat and their Nephila wife. She spent her young adulthood exploring every form of hedonism available to that world.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Nephilim Ascended
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is an ascended of the nephilim: a Grand Matron. What little of her previous life she could remember, if she chose, she doesn't bother to. Her personality has long been subsumed, lost in a haze of gorging, fucking, and basking in the adoring praise of the proles who have fallen under the influence of her Mind Warmth.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Construction worker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers enjoying her work, engaging in the construction of large structures both in space and on solid ground as a constructor-mech pilot. While she didn't plan the buildings themselves, she took pride in her work.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: mech engineer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers working hard, day in, and day out, studying and fixing mechs for the Nephilim navy and Constructor Corps. She earned a reputation for being able to fix anything that was carried into her workshop, garnering much acclaim.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: First Responder
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers frequently tending to minor workplace accidents, providing first-response care and first-aid to small injuries. While she scarcely had to deal with major accidents, her work taught her much about patching wounds.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers living in one of the densely populated womb worlds of the Nephilim. She worked in a massive science center with thousands of other intellectuals.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Resource-procurement Specialist
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Resources are critical for expansion, and {PAWN_nameDef} remembers being one of many in charge of gathering them. She would go to deposits, program the constructor mechs to set up equipment, and do what was necessary to extract all valuable resources.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Exploration officer
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: Exploration is always needed, be it across the surface of a planet, down in the depths of the ocean, or up in the darkest reaches of space, and {PAWN_nameDef} remembers being one who was out there searching. She searched, charted, logged, and explored every form of reproduction and fertility she could find, investigating new opportunities for her species.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Hydroponics worker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers working in a giant hydroponics facility on one of the fully converted womb worlds of the Nephilim. As a result, {PAWN_nameDef}'s expertise in planting, food preparation, and maintaining the machinery that kept the facility operational was highly valued. This importance, unfortunately, went to her head.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Digger
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.baseDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} remembers being born on a womb world in the early stages of conversion. It was still wooded, and {PAWN_nameDef} could frequently be found digging in the mud as a child, excavating potholes in the garden. She also learned a little about re-planting when she was forced to fix what was dug.
